name: mushroom
source: the game's pickup text "Tu as trouvé le Champignon!" (champignon: mushroom), read at frame 91353 in room 80/0 just before id 12 was gained at 91615 (held [1,4] to [1,4,12]) in runs 20261124-190747-626d, 20261124-190802-731e and 20261124-191123-4c7e (G1 forks of checkpoint 20261114-084732-45ba frame 90581, clean harness); one lineage, since all three fork from the same state and reach the text on the same frame; then the delivery text « Tu m'apportes le Champignon qui endort » read while id 12 was held with 0xDB4B 1, at room 162/14 in runs 20261125-232412-ef41 (frame 99500) and 20261125-232411-2dd7 (frame 100801), forks of 20261124-191800-abbe at frames 94304 (post-gain) and 95758 (respawn), so one lineage with the pickup runs
note: replaces the hypothesis "magic powder" taken from general knowledge of the item ids; id 12 takes the form magic powder after the delivery

forms.name: magic powder
forms.source: powder probe 2026-11-25 (scripts in ~/.capy/work/koho-powder/): per-frame diff of 0xD800-0xDDFF over the mushroom delivery at room 162/14 in runs 20261125-232412-ef41 (frames 99300-100400) and 20261125-232411-2dd7 (frames 100600-101700), forks of 20261124-191800-abbe at frames 94304 (post-gain, room 172) and 95758 (respawn, room 171): after the text « Tu as la Poudre Magique! », item 12 came back to the B button on the frame magic_powder went 0 -> 0x20 (ef41 100134, 2dd7 101445), with 0xDB4B cleared 750 frames earlier as the mushroom left; control: forks 20261125-220450-15df and 20261125-213346-099b of the same parent at frame 94304, which never delivered the mushroom, keep 0xDB4C at 0 and 0xDB4B at 1 with item 12 held on every keyframe from 95400 to 106304
forms.note: same item id as the mushroom; a positive magic_powder count names it; one lineage (both runs fork abbe): a delivery from another root lineage verifies it

pickups.source: model-free stub runs from checkpoint 20261114-084732-45ba frame 90581, 4200 frames: 20261123-234531-c61d frame 93790 and 20261123-235327-873e frame 93940, each gaining id 12 at 80/0 as held went [1,4] to [1,4,12], from a scene that starts when an explore brings Link into contact with uncatalogued entity type 58 from the cell above it (Link at [2,2], the entity at [3,2], link_frozen from 93441 in c61d); the harness then advances 9 text pages the stub did not transcribe, and the item byte (inventory slot 0 = 12) appears at 93790, about 350 frames after contact
pickups.note: one lineage: both runs resume the same checkpoint, so the second measures nothing new; a gain from another lineage, or a game text naming the item, promotes it
